No DOM / lucide-react / Recharts / Leaflet / old web-UI imports — only RN primitives (View/Animated/StyleSheet/AccessibilityInfo/Easing), the native AppText/SemanticIcon/GlassPanel, the native AnimatedNumber parity port, and inline theme-token colours.

Behaviour / state names / i18n keys / unit handling preserved: the overallHealth !== 'good' banner gate, getAlertVariant/healthBadgeVariant resolvers, the good/warning/critical heading + icon + colour mapping, the 'Motor State: {motorStatus}' subtitle, the dynamic `drivetrain.health.${overallHealth}` badge key with toUpperCase fallback, and the suffix='%' health-score AnimatedNumber. No units are involved (health is a dimensionless % + status enum), so no SI conversion applies.

RN-unavailable / approximated web behaviours documented: web GlassPanel `glow` (hover-gated, inert here) dropped; Tailwind `cn` dropped; lucide CheckCircle/AlertTriangle -> SemanticIcon glyph chips (boxed 2-char glyphs at the nearest native size, tones green/amber/red); backdrop-blur-sm on the banner has no RN equivalent and is dropped (border+translucent bg retained); the sm: row/justify-between header variant collapses to the mobile-first column base.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
